cohort: Pregnant women at > 32 weeks of gestation admitted to Dayanand Medical College and Hospital (DMCH), Ludhiana, India from January 1, 2011, to December 31, 2011.
finding: Reactive NST at admission was associated with higher rates of vaginal delivery and lower rates of operative delivery, while non-reactive NST was associated with increased chances of operative delivery and NICU admission.
